field.label: Enable MCP Server
field.comment: Serves read-only commerce tools (product search, product cards, categories, store info) to AI agents at POST /mcp. Tools expose only what an anonymous shopper already sees. Add a full-page-cache bypass for /mcp — see the README for Varnish/LiteSpeed snippets.

field.label: Require Bearer Token
field.comment: When Yes, every request must carry an Access Token of an active Integration (System → Extensions → Integrations, grant it the MCP Server Agent Access resource). Revoking the integration instantly cuts agent access.

field.label: Log Agent Calls
field.comment: One JSON line per agent tool call in var/log/angeo_mcp_agent.jsonl (timestamp, tool, user agent, duration — never payloads or tokens). This is the data source for agent-traffic analytics.

group.label: Claude Connector
group.comment: Lets shoppers connect this store to Claude in one click. Paste the connector URL your MCP provider issued you, then place the generated button anywhere on the storefront.

field.label: Connector URL
field.comment: The HTTPS MCP endpoint shoppers connect to, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/t/your-store/mcp. Leave empty to hide the button. This is not your store's own /mcp path — that endpoint has no OAuth and cannot be added to Claude directly.

field.label: Connector Name
field.comment: Shown to the shopper in Claude's connector list. Defaults to the store name.

group.label: Agent presentation
group.comment: What an AI client reads about this store when it connects, before it decides whether to use your tools at all. These settings do not change what the tools do — they change how findable they are.

field.label: Store name for agents
field.comment: How the store is named to an AI client, e.g. "Acme Outdoor". Leave empty to use the store view name (or the website name when the store view is still called something generic like "Default Store View"). This is the name a shopper has to type for the model to match their request to this connector, so use the name customers actually know you by.

field.label: Agent instructions (override)
field.comment: Optional. Replaces the instructions sent to AI clients on connect. Leave empty to generate them from the store name and the tools actually installed — the generated text stays correct when you add or remove the checkout module, a hand-written one will not.

field.label: Add store name to tool descriptions
field.comment: Appends "Applies to the {store} store only." to every tool description. Helps a client tell your tools apart from another shop's when a shopper has several connectors enabled.

field.label: Generate tool titles
field.comment: Sets a human-readable title annotation on each tool ("Search Acme Outdoor products") for the client's permission screen. Without it clients show generic labels that read identically for every connected shop.

field.label: Price Customer Group
field.comment: Customer group whose prices agents see. Default: NOT LOGGED IN.

field.label: Rate Limit (requests/minute)
field.comment: Per client IP (plus token, when present). 0 disables the limiter.
